title: Present exact Project Item accounting labels and Unaccounted-only Link payer choices

requirements.invariant: Project Item accounting sections use exactly Unaccounted For Items and Accounted For Items, with Unaccounted For first. Target presentation does not expose proto/draft/promotion/assignment, linked/unlinked, occurrence/movement or inventory-sale terminology.

Only a Project Item already resolved by authoritative relationship evidence as Unaccounted For receives the Link presentation descriptor. Its action title is exactly Link, its question is exactly Who paid for this Item?, and its exhaustive semantic payer-choice set contains only Client paid and Business paid without imposing an unconfirmed display order.

Dismissing the payer question has no side effect and yields no Link route, command, operation, mutation or persisted payer selection. There is no Not sure choice; the source Item remains Unaccounted For.

Accounted For rows and rows whose relationship evidence remains incomplete fail closed for Link presentation. The projector consumes the verified derived accounting resolution and never re-derives accounting state from Space, category, price, detail completeness, Invoice presentation or another copied flag.

Presentation is a deterministic stateless projection over the verified ProjectItemAccountingSectionsSnapshot/rows. After canonical snapshot restart it is re-derived identically; no transient modal or payer state is serialized, and no second accounting query port, persistence boundary or authorization claim is created.

This Phase 1 leaf is executable only with deterministic provider-free synthetic evidence while the Firebase application remains unchanged. It implements no Link route/command, Purchase eligibility/selection, acquisition handling, correction/relink behavior, app/MCP UI wiring, schema/RLS/Sync/provider, migration, hosted resource, release or production behavior.

items: ProjectItemAccountingSectionKind projects to exact canonical section labels without changing the already verified Unaccounted-before-Accounted section order.
ProjectItemLinkPayerChoice is presentation-only semantic vocabulary with exactly clientPaid and businessPaid values and exact labels; it is not a future command payload or ordered menu policy.

ProjectItemLinkPresentationDescriptor is available only from an authoritative unaccountedFor ProjectItemAccountingRow and exposes exact action/question/choice membership plus a side-effect-free dismissal outcome.
ProjectItemLinkPresentationFailure supplies stable bounded accounted/incomplete refusal codes and no provider, Purchase, command or source detail.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and does not change or link either application project.
The slice cannot Link, relink, correct, select a Purchase, persist a payer choice, mutate accounting state, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-007/O-015/O-016/O-017/O-021/O-023/O-027/O-029/O-032/O-034 and all provider/hosted/migration gates remain outside the boundary.

verification.expected: Verified Unaccounted-before-Accounted sections project exact canonical labels, and an authoritative Unaccounted row projects exact Link/action/question text with an exhaustive unordered semantic choice set containing only Client paid and Business paid.

Accounted and relationship-evidence-incomplete rows fail closed through stable bounded codes; public presentation contains none of Not sure yet, Sell from Business Inventory, Assign Item, Needs Assignment, Linked Items, Unlinked Items or occurrence/movement terminology.

Canonical encode/decode of the verified accounting snapshot re-projects identical labels and Link descriptor; projection and dismissal leave the source row/snapshot byte-identical and serialize no transient modal/payer state.

The existing provider-free ProjectItemAccountingQuerying boundary emits a validated local snapshot whose section and authoritative Unaccounted rows project identically without a second port; cancellation/failure semantics remain owned by the verified dependency and no Link command or provider is invoked.

verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both staging builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming Link commands/routes, persistence, app/MCP, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Ready decision-independent Phase 1 presentation leaf only. A fresh primary-agent and independent read-only preflight approved exact product vocabulary, authoritative Unaccounted-only Link availability, exact prompt/two-choice membership and no-side-effect dismissal. Broader Link-flow behavior is explicitly NO-GO. The implementation must consume the verified Project Item accounting resolution, persist no transient state, add no query port and avoid asserting payer display order or Accounted-item actions. The two paths remain comment-only until this exact ready commit passes immutable CI.
